description.value: Coronation Market is a convenience store on Coronation Avenue in Duncan, in the heart of the Cowichan Valley on Vancouver Island. It sits in a residential neighbourhood and serves as a local resupply point for anyone passing through Duncan. Touring cyclists riding the Cowichan Valley corridor would find it a practical stop for provisions.
